desc:
🚗 Build roads, connect cities & grow a giant traffic empire across the WORLD!

🆕 UPDATE 2: THEMED MAPS!
• Themes now transform the map, sea & sky: sakura petals, tumbleweeds, neon & more
• Auto Build: roads build themselves
• New titles over your head: FUTURIST, SHERIFF, SAKURA…
• 9 new badges

🛣️ HOW TO PLAY
• Drag roads between cities: each arriving car earns money & XP
• Buy states & unlock whole countries with keys
• Upgrade towns to metropolises & boost your cars

⭐ FEATURES
• 390 states in 23 countries, from Alaska to Argentina
• 7 city themes: Modern, Western, Blossom, VIP & more
• Workshop: Silver, Gold & Diamond cars
• Co-op, gifts, daily rewards, offline income & leaderboards
• +10% XP per friend in your server, +10% money with ROBLOX PLUS!

👑 Play until Nov 10 for the OG title & badge!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
👥 Join the WE Interactive group for 15 min of 2x XP daily!
